purpose: Correct Evernorth ownership attribution, distinguish cash purchases from in-kind XRP contributions, reconcile the SEC closing amount with on-chain wallet attribution, and add the filing's custody, accounting, liquidity and yield-strategy disclosures.

material_corrections.corrected: SEC ownership table lists Ripple at 7.1% of Class A voting stock. Chris Larsen is listed at 9.9% beneficial ownership, with footnotes covering shares held by Ripple and a contributor-related entity and disclaiming pecuniary interest except as applicable. The Contributor Group Holders are separately described as 9.9% of voting power collectively.

material_corrections.prior: SBI's 39.9% voting power could be read as 39.9% economic ownership.
material_corrections.corrected: SBI-controlled entities hold 39.9% voting power and approximately 21.4% of Pubco common stock. Sponsor holds 61.4% of common stock but 19.9% voting power through Class C non-voting shares. Contributor Group Holders collectively 9.9% voting power; other funding subscribers 9.8%; public holders 20.5%. These are distinct voting/economic measures and overlapping beneficial-ownership attributions must not be summed.

material_corrections.prior: Evernorth's 473.276M XRP total was treated as one undifferentiated market purchase.
material_corrections.corrected: The filing's at-closing total is 473,276,430 XRP from six tranches. Only 84,365,876 XRP is explicitly purchased using $214.05M advance-funding cash at an average $2.53657058/XRP. The other tranches are XRP contributions/subscriptions in kind. Do not equate 473.276M treasury XRP with 473.276M of new spot demand.

material_corrections.prior: On-chain outflow of 370.346M XRP was treated as a clean reconciliation of the 473.276M holdings.
material_corrections.corrected: XRP Insights reports 103,129,905 XRP in 13 attributed wallets and 370,346,663 XRP moved outside that attributed set. These sum to 473,476,568, which is 200,138 XRP above the company-reported 473,276,430. The tracker separately identifies a 200,000 XRP Uphold transfer as a probable delayed-funding tranche; the filing confirms the 200,000 XRP tranche but does not independently confirm that exact wallet mapping. Treat the outflow total as a wallet-cluster attribution estimate, not a reconciled holdings disposition.

material_corrections.prior: BitGo custody and 21.8% attributed wallets could be read as conflicting custody claims.
material_corrections.corrected: SEC says 100% of Evernorth XRP is held in BitGo cold storage. XRP Insights attributes 13 2-of-3 multisig wallets with BitGo initialization fingerprints, but only 21.8% of reported holdings is currently located in that attributed set; remaining destinations are not attributed. This is a coverage gap in public wallet attribution, not proof that custody changed or assets were sold.

evernorth_closing_tranche_reconciliation.sbi_cash_commitment_overlap: SBI announced a $200M Evernorth commitment. SEC documents place SBI-controlled entities among Advance Funding Subscribers subject to a 39.9% ownership limit, while $214.05M aggregate advance-funding cash was used to buy 84.365876M XRP. Subscriber-level allocation of the $214.05M is not disclosed here. Do not add the $200M SBI commitment to the $214.05M cash purchase as if they were necessarily separate capital pools.
evernorth_closing_tranche_reconciliation.delayed_funding_note: The SEC filing confirms a 200,000 XRP delayed-funding subscription. XRP Insights' specific 199,999.999 XRP Uphold-to-Custody J match remains a wallet-attribution inference, not a filing-confirmed address ownership link.

limitations: Destination addresses for the 370.346663M outflow are not attributed by the tracker.
The 200,000 XRP delayed-funding wallet match is probable; the SEC confirms the tranche but not the specific Uphold wallet.
The 200,138 XRP arithmetic difference is unresolved and may involve the candidate 200,000 tranche plus dust/fees or other attribution effects.
Movement outside the attributed set does not establish exchange deposit, sale, loss of custody or beneficial ownership transfer.
SEC-reported BitGo cold storage covers the company-reported XRP; public wallet attribution currently covers only a subset.

governance_and_voting.caution: Chris Larsen's beneficial-ownership footnote includes shares held through Ripple and a contributor-related entity and includes a disclaimer. Ripple's 7.1%, Chris Larsen's 9.9%, and the Contributor Group's 9.9% are not additive independent blocks.

custody_and_insurance.bitgo_lending: Filing says BitGo is not authorized to pledge/lend/use XRP unless expressly directed by Evernorth as part of yield-generation strategies.
custody_and_insurance.classification: SEC_COMPANY_DISCLOSURE plus SECONDARY_PUBLIC_LEDGER_ATTRIBUTION; no proof of sale or custody loss.

october_12_2026.proceeds_use: general corporate purposes including acquisition of XRP; no specific XRP purchase from these proceeds verified

liquidity_accounting_and_capital.accounting_policy: XRP excluded from ASC 350-60 crypto fair-value accounting; indefinite-lived intangible asset under ASC 350-30, historical cost less accumulated impairment. Impairment uses the lowest observable intraday XRP price since acquisition; after write-down, cost basis is not marked back up when price rises.
liquidity_accounting_and_capital.operating_liquidity: SEC says Ripple-contributed 126,791,458 XRP can be liquidated to fund operating costs; company relies on XRP contributions and Ripple facilities. This is an explicit potential supply source, not evidence of a sale.
liquidity_accounting_and_capital.xrp_per_share: Primary KPI, defined as XRP attributable to Pubco divided by Class A plus Class C shares outstanding. No reliable closing per-share figure until final share count/closing filing is reconciled.
liquidity_accounting_and_capital.additional_financing: Company may raise equity/debt and acquire more XRP; it may also monetize holdings for expenses, strategic opportunities and liquidity. Management timing/amounts are not fixed.

yield_strategy_and_ecosystem.status: SEC describes initial DeFi participation after closing; no current protocol names, deployed amounts, hedge notionals or loan counterparties disclosed.
yield_strategy_and_ecosystem.material_deployment: Prospectus states no material ecosystem deployment was anticipated before Q4 2026; initial participation is described as limited. Q4 has begun, but current positions remain undisclosed.
yield_strategy_and_ecosystem.market_geography: Japan and South Korea emphasized by company; the company's claim that Korea represents 18–22% of global XRP volume is not independently verified in this record.
risk_hypotheses: Additional cash-funded XRP purchases could create spot demand if executed in public markets; venue and future amount undisclosed.
In-kind contributions do not equal new spot-market demand at the time of treasury receipt.
Covered calls/basis trades may generate yield but introduce hedging, basis and derivatives feedback.
DeFi lending/AMM deployment may deepen liquidity but also expose XRP to leverage, collateral liquidation and smart-contract/counterparty risk.
Operating losses and the explicit ability to liquidate Ripple-contributed XRP create a potential supply source.
Equity/debt issuance may fund additional XRP purchases but can dilute XRP-per-share if issuance is not accretive.
